title: WallContract
description: The only interface between the Python pipeline and the frontend. Phase 1 delivers this as a build-time JSON file; a later HTTP API serves the identical shape at the same path, so the frontend does not change.

generated_at.description: The knowledge moment this payload reconstructs. Not merely a build timestamp: the store is bitemporal, so a wall can be rebuilt as it stood on any past date.

panels.description: Ordered by the causal chain: capacity leads price by 10-12 months, margin decides whether a capacity move persists.

revises.description: Whether upstream restates this series after the fact. True only for 能繁母猪存栏, which is also the only real leading indicator — the coincidence that justifies bitemporal storage.

threshold.description: A reference line that means something in the domain, not chart decoration.

points.description: Ascending by date. Each point keeps its own granularity: this series genuinely mixes annual, quarterly and monthly readings, and flattening them would claim they are equivalent measurements.

readings.description: Latest value per series with its position in its own history. Context for a human judgement, never a verdict.
